bullets.text: In Gummidipoondi, a worker died while engaged in replacing chemical powder at a factory.
Near Tiruttani, a 13-year-old deaf boy crossing railway tracks after going out to relieve himself in Mathur Colony was hit by a train and killed.
On Sardar Patel Road, Adyar police arrested a 28-year-old man named Babu for robbing 24 lakh rupees from a pharmaceutical company sales manager.
Along the Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road, authorities are considering flyover plans and infrastructure improvements to ease traffic congestion while protecting the Pallikaranai marshland.
In Tiruvanmiyur, police arrested an auto-rickshaw driver who spoke obscenely to a college student waiting at a bus stop.
In Pallikaranai, a domestic dispute involving a husband returning from Singapore and a TVK functionary drew local controversy and police attention.

At the North Chennai Thermal Power Station in Ponneri, workers staged a protest demonstration demanding the withdrawal of the smart meter scheme and the protection of the electricity sector as public property.
Near Uthukottai and Gummidipoondi in Pethikuppam, auto drivers staged a sudden protest demanding the cancellation of free bus travel.
In Tiruttani, parents expressed deep concern over 98 government, municipal, and aided schools operating without perimeter boundary walls.
Chief Minister Vijay unveiled the Tamil Nadu Semiconductor Ecosystem Policy 2026 to position the state as India's premier hub with customized investment incentives.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay and Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong jointly inaugurated a major 46 MW data centre established by CapitaLand in Ambattur.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi appreciated healthcare innovations developed by MEDxAI Innovations, a deep-tech startup incubated at VIT Chennai.
Greater Chennai Corporation Mayor R Priya criticised the TVK government for cancelling tenders worth at least 700 crore rupees for various city projects.
News channels questioned whether Tamil Nadu ranked first in price rises and sought explanations regarding the cost of living under the Vijay government.
Following the disappearance of a 7-year-old girl near Gingee, TVK announced a two lakh rupee reward for information leading to her whereabouts.
